definitions.explanation: A large printed picture or notice for display.

examples.japanese: ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ポスター⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{剥|は}がした→剥がす：00081_hagasu⟧。
examples.english: I took down the poster from the wall.

examples.japanese: ポスター⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧。
⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ポスター⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飾|かざ}ってある→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。

notes:
ポスター is a loanword from English "poster." It refers to any large printed sheet for public display.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ポスター⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧: to put up a poster
- ポスター⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{剥|は}がす→剥がす：00081_hagasu⟧: to take down/peel off a poster
- ポスター⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧: to display a poster
- ポスター⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧: to draw/design a poster

TYPES:
- ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧ポスター: movie poster
- ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧ポスター: election poster
- ⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧ポスター: advertising poster
- ⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧ポスター: recruitment/wanted poster

CULTURAL NOTE:
During elections in Japan, candidates' posters are displayed on designated public bulletin boards (⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦{掲示板|けいじばん}→掲示板：03052_keijiban⟧). Unauthorized posting is illegal. School children often create ポスター for contests on topics like fire safety or traffic rules.
